spans.s:
(ऊ, ऌ) ऊकृपॢ r. 1st cl. (कल्पते)
To be able.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (कल्पति, कल्पयति)
1 To think or imagine.
2 To mix.
3 To paint or colour.
r. 1st cl. (कृपति)
To have pity or mercy^1.
r. 10th cl. (कृपयति)
To be weak. In the first roots ल ॡ is substituted for ऋ.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-पः)
1 The name of a sage, the brother-in-law of DROṆ

A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas.
f. (-पा)
Tenderness, compassionateness.
f. (-पी)
The wife of the sage DROṆA.
E.
कृप to be able, &c. अङ् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Miserly, avaricious.
2 Low, vile.
3 Poor, feeble, miserable, pitiable.
m. (-णः)
A worm.
E.
कृप to be able, क्वुन् or ल्युट् aff.

m. (-णः)
A sword, a scymitar or sacrificial knife.
f. (-णी)
1 A knife.
2 A shears or scissors^1.
4 A dagger.
E.
कृपा mercy, नुद to destroy, ड aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-कः)
A sword, a scymitar: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to कृपाण.

f. (-का)
A knife.
E.
कन् added to कृपाण, and the fem. aff.

m. (-तः)
One of the Buddhas or deified saints of the Bauddhas.
E.
कृपा compassion, and अद्वैत not second; unequalled for tenderness.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Compassionate, tender.
E.
कृपा tenderness, आलुक् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unfeeling, unkind, hardhearted.
E.
कृपा, हीन devoid of.

A wood, a forest.
4 Wood, timber.
E.
कृप to be able, कीटन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
1 The ocean.
2 A rudder or large oar used as one.
3 Air, wind.
E.
कृपीट water, पाल what preserves, &c. अच् aff.

m. (-निः)
Fire.
E.
कृपीट water, योनि source, place of origin.

m. (-तिः)
A name of DROṆĀCĀRYA.
E.
कृपी the wife of the sage, and पति master.

m. (-त्रः)
AŚVATTHĀMA a sage, the son of KṚPĪ and DROṆA.
E.
कृपी, and पुत्र a son, or with other synonyms of a son, as कृपीसुत, &c.
